name: Gregory VII (Hildebrand)
biography: The central reforming Pope (1073-1085) who enforced clerical celibacy, initiated the investiture controversy, and clashed with Emperor Henry IV, forcing his penitential submission at Canossa (1077) before ultimately dying in exile under Norman protection after Henry's later triumph.
